I’m ranking by expected funding severity as well as hit probability, so a higher-probability shallow-touch candidate can rank below a lower-probability name with a history of sustained deep episodes.

All 15 selections passed `quiet__eq: true`. Probabilities are anchored to the 10% unconditional quiet-coin hit rate and the roughly 30–40% rates for repeat-offender and cross-venue setups. Pair-removal announcements are treated as possible liquidity constraints—not proof that all spot trading or borrowing is unavailable.
